metadata.name: FGE_PRODUCT_FLOW_STATE_MACHINE
metadata.full_name: FGE-OS CAMPUS UNIVERSAL PIPELINE & GATING SYSTEM v2.0 — Machine-Readable State Machine
metadata.description: Executable state machine defining the 7-stage universal pipeline, mandatory gating procedures, floor-specific variations, failure handling (including Kintsugi Repair), Product Index updates, and automated routing logic for the fge-artifact-synthesis-orchestrator and fge-product-engine. Converts descriptive architecture into programmable manufacturing logic.
metadata.upgrade_path: n+1 (descriptive) → n+2 (this implementation) → n+3 (automated orchestration layer)
metadata.provenance: User directive formalized by FGE Executive Intelligence System per Execution Doctrine Registry v1.0
metadata.compliance: Full adherence to Object Class Rules for SYSTEMS, Anti-Drift Protocol, Commercial Capture Law, and Visual Production Standard (where applicable to diagrams)

universal_stages.name: Intake & State Loading
universal_stages.description: Load approved states from registries and reference correct Glass Plate from Hyperreflective Glass Protocol.
universal_stages.failure_condition: Missing registry reference → automatic return to previous floor

universal_stages.name: Build / Synthesis
universal_stages.description: Fully render or synthesize the asset using loaded states. Create minimum technical deliverables (master + supporting AOVs).

universal_stages.name: Quality Gating (Light Purity + Contamination Filter)
universal_stages.description: Critical optical and purity validation. Calculate Light Purity Score and classify contamination.
universal_stages.on_failure: Automatic Kintsugi Repair loop → return to Stage 2 with specific remediation notes

universal_stages.name: Packaging & Documentation
universal_stages.description: Assemble complete ship-ready package including all required components.
required_deliverables: Full metadata block (Light Purity Score, archetype, registries used, provenance)
Supporting files (prompt DNA, reference_match_language.yaml, AOV package)

universal_stages.name: Product Index Registration
universal_stages.description: Register asset in the current floor’s Product Index with unique ID and initial status.

universal_stages.name: Maven / Floor-Specific Optimization
universal_stages.description: Floor 2 primary gate. Review for commercial sharpness and apply minor mutations if needed.
universal_stages.authorized_floor: Floor 2 (System Vault) only for final 'Ready to Ship' certification

universal_stages.name: Ship-Ready Certification → Move to Next Floor or Release
universal_stages.description: Final sign-off. Asset advances or is released to Economic Engine.
actions: Move to next floor’s Product Index OR release to Floor 3 Economic Engine
All previous floors retain full lineage record

gate2_build.name: Build Gate
gate2_build.on_fail: Remain in Stage 2 until deliverables complete

gate3_optical_purity.name: Optical & Purity Gate (Critical)
gate3_optical_purity.on_fail: Kintsugi Repair loop: return to Stage 2 with remediation notes attached to asset state

gate4_packaging.name: Packaging Gate
checks: All required deliverables present (master, glass overlays, metadata, supporting files, commercial text)
gate4_packaging.on_fail: Return to Stage 4 until package complete

gate5_product_index.name: Product Index Registration Gate
actions: Create unique ID in current floor Product Index
gate5_product_index.on_pass: Proceed to Stage 6 (or Floor 2 Maven if applicable)

gate6_maven_optimization.name: Maven / Floor Optimization Gate (Floor 2 Primary)
checks: Minor mutations or improvements applied if needed
gate6_maven_optimization.on_fail: Return to Stage 4 or 5 with specific improvement directives

gate7_ship_ready.name: Ship-Ready Certification Gate
checks: All prior gates passed and lineage recorded
gate7_ship_ready.on_pass: Asset moved to next floor’s Product Index OR released to Floor 3 Economic Engine
gate7_ship_ready.lineage_requirement: All previous floors retain complete lineage record

floor1_manufacturing_engine.notes: Assets enter Floor 1 Product Index as 'Packaged' after Gate 5. No final ship certification here.

floor2_system_vault_product_observatory.only_authorized_to: certify assets as 'Ready to Ship' for external release
floor2_system_vault_product_observatory.notes: The true quality and packaging heart of the operation. All external releases must pass through here.

floor3_economic_engine.input_requirement: Only assets already marked 'Ready to Ship' from Floor 2
floor3_economic_engine.output: Commercial offers, sales channels, buyer packages

floor4_evolution_reactor.entry_point: Re-enter pipeline from Stage 2 with evolution notes attached
floor4_evolution_reactor.pipeline_override: Same 7-stage pipeline with additional governance gates for higher strategic value
floor4_evolution_reactor.notes: Assets can loop here for controlled evolution before re-entering main flow.

floors_5_plus_penthouse.additional_gates: Extra governance and strategic review layers
floors_5_plus_penthouse.notes: Penthouse-level assets receive maximum oversight and collector-grade treatment.

gate3_fail.required: specific remediation notes from purity/contamination failure

after_gate7_pass.then: advance to next floor Product Index

status_progression: Ready to Ship (only after Gate 6 on Floor 2)
product_index_rules.lineage_requirement: Every asset must retain immutable record of all previous floors and gates passed

orchestrator_integration.routing_logic: Asset state machine evaluates current stage/gate result + current floor Product Index status → determines next action (advance, repair, optimize, release, or re-enter evolution)
orchestrator_integration.n+3_readiness: This state machine provides the exact logic layer required for full automated orchestration between floors based on gate results and Product Index status.

failure_handling_summary.kintsugi_repair: Primary remediation path for Gate 3 failures. Returns asset to Stage 2 with attached diagnostic notes. Designed to preserve value while enforcing quality.
failure_handling_summary.automatic_returns: Gate 1 and certain packaging failures trigger immediate return to prior state/floor without manual intervention.
failure_handling_summary.escalation: Repeated failures on the same asset trigger review by Floor 2 Maven or higher governance.

implementation_notes.canon_status: Fully canonized as operational building code for FGE-OS Campus.
implementation_notes.anti_drift: All rules, thresholds, and transitions are now explicit and machine-readable to prevent future drift.
implementation_notes.commercial_value: Enables scalable, auditable, high-quality asset manufacturing with clear path to monetization on Floor 3.
implementation_notes.next_recommended: Integrate this JSON directly into fge-artifact-synthesis-orchestrator for live automated routing (n+3 upgrade).
